name: Compass Gas e Energia S.A.
summary: Compass Gas e Energia S.A. engages in distribution and promotion of natural gas in Brazil. The company operates through two operating segments: Gas Distribution and Marketing and Services. It engages in distribution of piped natural gas, origination, commercialization and gas supply infrastructure, as well as the development of solutions aligned with the energy transition, including biomethane projects. The company serves serves customers in the residential, commercial, industrial, automotive, cogeneration, and thermoelectric generation. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in São Paulo, Brazil. Compass Gas e Energia S.A. is a subsidiary of Cosan Dez Participacoes S. A.
